resources.string: It answers in a natural voice whatever is not in their phrases, using what you wrote in the profile. To talk to it, the person says its name and the question: “Grace, is Ana coming today?”. Their phrases still answer first, and without internet.
A common word that is easy to remember: Grace, Joy, Rose… The phone recognizes it without internet.
The phone\'s voice says it if there is no internet or the AI does not answer.
Once reached, only their phrases answer until the next day, and you will see a notice here.
Without saying its name. It may answer the TV or a visitor, and it uses more answers.
To see what it would answer, type a question at the end of the Profile.
What was heard and what it answered, as text. If it did not understand the question well, you will see here what it heard. They are deleted automatically after 7 days.
Sign in with your email to manage, from this phone, the phrases, schedule and reminders of the people you care for.
Choose again who uses this phone
No patients yet. Tap “Add patient” to create the first one.
No phrases yet. Tap “New phrase” to create the first one.
Tap a phrase to change its words or its sound.
On the caregiver\'s phone, tap “Link phone” next to the person. Then scan the QR code here or type the 8-character code.
So the AI answers the way someone who knows them would. Everything is optional: write only what you want to share. Do not include diagnoses or medication doses; the AI does not need them.
What they like to be called
For example: Mary, or Mrs. Smith
Where and who they live with
For example: at home, with her daughter Lucy. On Tuesdays Rose comes to help her.
For example: Charles, her son, lives in another city. Her grandchildren are Tom and Sophie.
For example: she gets up at 8, has lunch at 1 and watches her show in the afternoon.
What they like and what calms them
For example: old songs, talking about her hometown, being spoken to slowly.
Sensitive topics and how to answer them
For example: if she asks about George, her husband, who passed away, tell her George loved her very much and talk about her grandchildren.
Whatever you want it to know that does not fit above.
What it can do without asking you
Only when the person asks the AI. It first says what it is going to do, and “Stop” cancels it. Everything starts turned off.
Turn the flashlight on or off
Their phrases do not log any dose yet. Create one in “Phrases and settings” with the action “Log a dose” or with a reminder that has “Done”.
To the help alert contacts from their phrases, with the same question “Do you need help?” and the 10 seconds to cancel.
Type something they might ask and you will see what the AI would answer with this profile, even if you have not saved it. Nothing plays on their phone and nothing is done.
For example: is Ana coming today?
Who is going to use this phone?
From here you set up the phrases, schedule and reminders of one or more people.
It is for the person I care for
This phone only listens and answers. It is linked once with the caregiver\'s code, with no account or password.
Use on a single phone, without an account
As before: everything is set up and listened to on this same phone.
On the person\'s phone, open Earcaster, choose “It is for the person I care for” and scan this code. It is valid for 10 minutes.
Press record and make the sound. 30 seconds maximum.
Today it reached the maximum number of assistant answers. Until tomorrow only their phrases answer.
Word or phrase that triggers the response
Tap the microphone to dictate it. Separate several forms with commas: thirteen, the thirteen. A reminder can have no phrase.
Alert that they need help (“I fell”)
The person\'s name, for the message

When it hears the phrase it will say “Do you need help? I am going to alert Charles” and wait 10 seconds: if it hears “I am fine” or “no”, it does not alert. Otherwise it sends a text: “Earcaster: Mary said \"I fell\" at 17:10. Call to check on them”. If the text does not go out, it calls. Nothing else leaves the phone.
It will first say “Calling Charles” and then call on speakerphone. To avoid calls by mistake, the phrase needs at least two words (“call Charles”) and the highest precision is required.
It will say “Light on”. The flashlight turns itself off after 10 minutes.
For example “morning pill”. It will say “Noted: morning pill, at 9:05 in the morning”; it is logged as said aloud, the least certain kind.
It is read aloud. Tap a data field so it says the time, the day or the date at that moment.
Drag the ends to keep only the part you want. Press ▶ to hear it.
Also play it at a set time, without anyone asking
Show a large “Done” button on the screen

Optional. For example “morning pill”. That way “did I take my pill?” can answer with what was logged.

While it listens you will see a persistent notification: Android requires it to use the microphone in the background. Everything is processed on the phone; nothing is recorded or sent.
So that a phrase like “when is Ana coming?” says the next visit. In that phrase\'s spoken response, tap “+ visit”.

The visits the family writes down in a shared calendar, for example “Ana\'s visit” on Sunday at 13:00. Everyone can add them from their own phone. The calendar is only read; nothing leaves this phone.
None. They are for someone who always comes on the same day, or if the family does not use a calendar.

So that what you set up reaches each person's phone, this is stored in Google's cloud (Firebase): your email, each person's name, their phrases, responses and recordings, their visit schedule, their reminders and the alert contacts.

From their phone come the logged doses, the help alerts and whether it is listening. What is heard never leaves the phone: the microphone is processed right there and nothing is recorded.

You can delete your account with all this data whenever you want, from the menu.

Earcaster is not an emergency service. It may not hear, the phone may close it or have no signal. For emergencies use a panic button or call the emergency number.\n\nThe alert sends a text message with what was said and the time. Nothing else leaves the phone.

Who writes the answers: Claude, by Anthropic, or Muse Spark, by Meta. The rules, the profile and the voice are the same with both.
With Muse Spark, the text of what the person says, the profile, the time, their visits and today\'s doses will go to Meta instead of Anthropic. The voice is still ElevenLabs.
Muse Spark, by Meta, reads today\'s conversations, doses and alerts and tells you how the day went. It only says what is written down.
